datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
select p.numberofcredit,psh.PRINCIPAL,psh.INTEREST,psh.PRINCIPAL+psh.INTEREST odcem,psh.PAYMENTDATE,v.val_name,cm_common.get_accname(ac.CONTRACTACCID)  as name ,e.name exname, l.phonenumber ,cm_utils.Get_PlanPrincipal(p.ID, sbop.get_date) eo,interestrest,penaltyrest,cm_utils.Get_PlanPrincipal(p.ID, sbop.get_date) +interestrest+penaltyrest  cem 
,interestrest+((h.rest*annualyinterestrate/36000)*(:dat1-:dat)) proq from
cm_active_credits p,cm_history h,CM_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE psh,smart.avalute_t v,cm_accounts ac,cm_expert e,cm_boorowerinfo l
where p.id=h.creditid and ac.creditid=p.id and p.id=l.creditid and
     h.hdate =sbop.get_date and h.rest+h.duerest>0
     and psh.creditid=p.id and p.expertid=e.id(+) and (((h.rest+h.duerest)>psh.rest) or(psh.PRINCIPAL=0))  and
     psh.PAYMENTDATE between :dat and :dat1 and
     p.currency=v.valute

/*8gh*/ 


order by p.numberofcredit
